items.recapEn: On Shiomizaka, in rare clear air, Hana could not help stopping at every bend, and saw Fuji for the last time, a faint shape between sea and sky. She could not not call home on her mother's birthday; her mother asked about the cat first. Maeda-san, sweeping the slope, gave them a roasted sweet potato. Fuji: last. Mother: fine.

items.recapEn: Climbing Shiomizaka, Hana kept stopping and Ken kept teasing. They spotted a faint Fuji and agreed they could not not look. Maeda-san, sweeping the top, handed them a hot sweet potato; Ken split it and gave Hana the bigger half. Hana had to call her mother, knowing she would be told Fuji is visible from Yokohama too.
